purpose: Teach: 糞/ガール/うーむ/じゃぁ/仔/菊/帖/フン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「糞、忘れ物だ」って慌てて戻られたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad rushed back, swearing he forgot something.
lines.style: Warm amusement tinged with affection. Light, knowingly wry — she's sharing a small secret with him about his father. Quick delivery, eyes crinkling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ガールの友達と仲良くね」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad told me to make friends with the girls.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest clarity. Small voice but steady. He's repeating something important his father said. A hint of pride that he was given this instruction at all.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「うーむ、これは旨い」って唸ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was making these satisfied sounds about how good the food is.
lines.style: Soft, private observation. Slightly amused. She's noticing something tender about his father — the unselfconscious way he expresses pleasure. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「じゃぁ、お弁当持って行こう」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad told me we should bring a packed lunch next time.
lines.style: Bright, eager small voice. He's delivering this like it's an invitation, a plan being made. Quick cadence — the excitement of anticipation. Open, hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが仔犬と遊んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's going to play with the puppy.
lines.style: Warm, gentle tone. She's sharing something small and genuine about his father. Unhurried, almost wistful — noticing the tenderness in the simple act.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに菊の花の名前を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me the names of the chrysanthemums.
lines.style: Quiet reverence in his voice. He's been given knowledge, been treated like someone worth teaching. Simple, clear delivery — this matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「四帖半でも立派な書斎」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said even a small room can be a proper study space.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. She's sharing something his father mused aloud — practical wisdom wrapped in acceptance. Warm delivery, slightly reflective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「フン、まだ序の口」って試されたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad gave me a hard look and said I was just getting started.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware wit. Small laugh underneath — he knows he's been tested, slightly embarrassed but pleased. Quick, light delivery masking that he's proud of the challenge.
